title: fx signal
description: Exchange rate from Frankfurter (ECB reference rates), fetched hourly; ECB publishes once per working day. GET /api/signals/fx, polled every 30 min; 404 unless providers.fx.enabled (opt-in network); null until the first fetch. Persisted across restarts. Not sensitive.

rate.description: Units of `quote` per 1 `base` (e.g. JPY per USD).

prev.description: The last DIFFERENT rate seen (for an up/down arrow), or null if none yet.

at.description: When it was fetched. Unix time in seconds (float).
